headline: Record operating profit on higher revenue
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 28.77T, up 39.7% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 3.70T, up 532.5% y/y and KRW 217.0B higher than last quarter.
summary_long: Third-party coverage reports a single-quarter operating profit above the company's prior record annual figure of KRW 1.07T, set in 2022. Revenue was KRW 383.4B lower than last quarter. Net income of KRW 2.59T compares with a KRW 107.9B loss a year ago. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results; net income is the Yahoo shard value. Shard operating income (KRW 4.76T) does not match the reported KRW 3.70T and is not used.
